title: Quartz Crafting Mod
description: A balanced equipment expansion that bridges the gap between Iron and Diamond tiers.
body:
**Smelt Quartz into Ingots: Utilize your Nether Quartz by smelting it into durable Quartz Ingots.

New Tier of Equipment: Craft a full set of Quartz tools, weapons, and armor.

Perfectly Balanced: Designed to sit comfortably between Iron and Diamond. Features 800 durability and a 7.0 mining speed—superior to Iron but more accessible than Diamond.

Full Enchantment Support: All Quartz gear is fully compatible with Enchanting Tables, allowing for powerful magical upgrades.

Technical Specs:
Durability: 800

Mining Speed: 7.0

Enchantability: 14 (Equal to Iron)**
